title: Bridging the tooling gap with Scala.js

blocks.html: Scala.js is a tool for compiling your Scala code to JavaScript. This enables writing type-safe and robust front-end application, but have you ever considered what it can do for Scala tooling? In this talk we’ll see how Scala.js can bridge the gap between the Scala-based and the JavaScript-based tools we use every day as programmers.
